source_claim: AlphaEvolve-style long budgeted searches need provider calls, timeouts, retries, and cancellation behavior to be attributable to the controller's compute budget
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve has validated provider request timeout rules, ensemble wait deadline rules, runtime deadline rules, declared hard-cancellation rules, role-scoped budget actions, artifact-kind requirements, a cancellation-record artifact gate, hashed artifact inventory checks, runtime readiness false fields, provider-cancellation observations, timeout failure call records, cancellation-record ledger replay, role/backend quarantine observations, and provider failure-policy summaries. It does not claim live provider SDK cancellation, in-flight cancellation handles, timeout-driven stop enforcement, cross-run provider quarantine resume, richer role-specific timeout artifacts, or provider-output raw-payload replay.
